notes.title: EARLY ACCESS - Update 2.2
notes.notes:
Hey guys, here's the update 2.2 of the Early Access period.

- Improved performance
- Added different sound effect's to each weapon including melee weapons
- Added different sound effect's to male and female enemies
- Fixed a bug in the AI that was causing them to be stuck running against walls
- Fixed car sound when destroyed

Whats next for the 2.3?

The next update will focused on new content including a new map, enemies, weapons, vehicles and also some different missions for the current map

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS - Update 2.1
notes.notes:
Hey guys, here's the update 2.1 of the Early Access period.

- Added Dismemberment chance for shotgun and machete weapons
- Added a new decal system, now when you hit an enemy there will be blood on their body
- Improved overall performance (more optimization will come in the next update 2.2)
- Fixed a bug that caused enemies to get up after being dead
- Mask mans no longer lose their mask after being killed
- Now when a car is destroyed it will be removed after some time

Whats next for the 2.2?

The next update will focused on sound effects, AI improvement and performance optimization and of coarse bug fixing

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS - Update 2
notes.notes:
Hey guys, the second update for The Purge Man is here:

- Added the ability to grab the npc's by the neck, you can use them as body shield, or execute any type of kill
- Added a new gun (flamethrower)
- Added a new mission to use the gun flamethrower
- Added a way to breach into certain houses
- Changed bullet impact physics when hitting an enemy to be more dynamic
- Fixed a bug with the melee weapons on vive/index where the weapon would become two handed and bugged
- Two handed weapons second hand is now toggled to grab
- Fixed a bug where you could pick the smartphone and the weapon/mag
- Fixed a bug where AK-47 mag would spawn under the spawning spot

Whats next?

- Dismemberment System for weapons such as Shotgun, Swords, Grenades
- Fully intractable store, meaning you will be able to pick any object in there and use them
- More buildings with interiors, like houses, coffees, restaurants, banks
- Ways to spend the collected money by buying grenades or attachments for the weapons
- Side quests like Heist
- New police helicopter with sniper in it, and also can spawn some swats
- New map and missions (The farm) this map will be connected with the town, you will start to feel the open world as you can travel from one map to the other using the vehicle
and the police can chase after you
- More missions to "The Town"
- More different cars
- Motorbike vehicle (some stunts?)

If you have suggestions or want to report bugs please join the Discord

I will consider any suggestion and fix any bug you will find when playing this game

https://discord.gg/rFyNzba

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS - Update 1
notes.notes:
Hey guys, the first update for The Purge Man is here:

- Added the ability to physical attack with GUNS
- Added Smooth Turn as a turning option 
- Fixed Shotgun glitches
- Fixed Sandbox Mode
- Fixed shooting while driving, gun would fall behind when accelerating the car
- Fixed a bug when picking up objects (it could pickup multiple objects)

Whats next?

- Improve AI
- New gun (Flame Thrower) 
- Physical Hand Combat
- Ability to grab enemies by the neck and execute some punch's / shooting kills etc (sky is the limit :D)

If you have suggestions or want to report bugs please join the Discord

I will consider any suggestion and fix any bug you will find when playing this game

https://discord.gg/rFyNzba
